thought.text: HTTP/2 doesn't support WebSocket upgrade properly. Let me force HTTP/1.1:

reasoning_content: Wait - the WebSocket config looks correct. But the curl is getting HTTP/2 404. Maybe it's because curl is using HTTP/2 for the upgrade request, but WebSocket upgrade requires HTTP/1.1. Let me try with HTTP/1.1:

action.command:
curl -v -k --http1.1 \
  -H "Host: arelorian.de" \
  -H "Connection: Upgrade" \
  -H "Upgrade: websocket" \
  -H "Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13" \
  -H "Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSB3b3JsZA==" \
  https://arelorian.de/ws 2>&1 | grep -E "HTTP|Upgrade|101"
